report_parsed.summary: Within the authorized 300-second window (2026-09-27T07:05:05Z to 07:10:05Z) on target m0-otel-20260909, the sampled evidence does not corroborate a checkout failure. Checkout's span call-rate metric returned only a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series (0.21-0.45 calls/s), no ERROR-labeled checkout series; the only ERROR-labeled series returned anywhere in the window were payment GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect, all reported as 0 at every step; the status_code=ERROR span query returned series for frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator and payment only, all with value 0 at every step. All sampled checkout traces (traceIDs ffb9b379e6ab520eaa9fb71a95935f9c, 29301c934c2b48bf73ae040929e13638, 26dc024bea07ff130063083b9465ca3e, 53e77c5ff948f37553beb97b1ebeaf05, 7912840a9fda6d411a02e55f9e74f5ff, 072fccebc99383c0ff82a49a057ab979) show rpc.grpc.status_code 0 / http.status_code 200 with no error tags, and dependency spans in payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping and email likewise show only success status codes, with durations in the sub-millisecond to low-millisecond range. Checkout's own server-side p95 latency is reported between ~93 ms and 220 ms inside the window, far above every sampled dependency latency, but no pre-window baseline was authorized or queried, so an elevated-latency trend cannot be confirmed or refuted. The result is therefore partial: no observed failures, but latency and error-rate conclusions are limited by sampling, absent baseline and absent ERROR-labeled checkout series.

claims.text: The checkout span call-rate query returned exactly one series, service_name=checkout with status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET, with 5-minute rates between 0.208 and 0.451 across the window; no ERROR-status checkout series appeared in the result.

The dependency span call-rate query over payment|product-catalog|cart|currency|shipping|email returned 25 series; the only ERROR-labeled series were payment GET, payment dns.lookup and payment tcp.connect, each reported as 0 at all 11 steps, while all remaining series carried STATUS_CODE_UNSET or STATUS_CODE_OK (currency Currency/Convert).

Checkout's client-side RPC duration counts returned 7 series (Charge, Convert, EmptyCart, GetCart, GetProduct, GetQuote, ShipOrder), all with rpc_grpc_status_code=0; no non-zero gRPC status-code series was present for checkout client calls.

Sampled checkout spans show no failures: six oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and durations 37930-92126 microseconds (traceIDs ffb9b379e6ab520eaa9fb71a95935f9c, 29301c934c2b48bf73ae040929e13638, 26dc024bea07ff130063083b9465ca3e, 53e77c5ff948f37553beb97b1ebeaf05, 7912840a9fda6d411a02e55f9e74f5ff, 072fccebc99383c0ff82a49a057ab979), plus HTTP POST spans with http.status_code 200 and success-status CartService/EmptyCart, ShippingService/GetQuote and PaymentService/Charge child calls; error_by_visible_tags was false on every returned span.

The error-status span metric query returned series only for frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator and payment, and every value was 0 at all 11 steps; no checkout, cart, currency, shipping, email or product-catalog ERROR-status series was returned by that query.

Server-side p95 latency (histogram_quantile over rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_bucket) was returned for only two services: checkout, ranging from 220 ms at window start to 93.75-96.25 ms at window end, and product-catalog, stable at approximately 4.79-4.85 ms.

Checkout client-side p95 latency by rpc_method was Charge 23.1-24.1 ms, EmptyCart 22.75-23.88 ms, GetQuote 20.5-45 ms, Convert 5.5-16 ms, GetCart 4.75-9.25 ms, GetProduct 4.75 ms and ShipOrder 4.75 ms across the window.

Sampled payment spans show only successes: grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge durations 1851-6783 microseconds and charge durations 888-1429 microseconds, all with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and error_by_visible_tags false, on traceIDs 26dc024bea07ff130063083b9465ca3e, 29301c934c2b48bf73ae040929e13638, 53e77c5ff948f37553beb97b1ebeaf05, 7912840a9fda6d411a02e55f9e74f5ff, ffb9b379e6ab520eaa9fb71a95935f9c and 072fccebc99383c0ff82a49a057ab979.

Sampled cart spans (AddItem, GetCart, EmptyCart, flagd ResolveBoolean, HGET, POST) had durations between 3645 and 15699 microseconds with empty status_tags and error_by_visible_tags false on all returned spans.

Sampled shipping spans show ShippingService/GetQuote at 4762-9696 microseconds and ShippingService/ShipOrder at 17-50 microseconds, all with rpc.grpc.status_code 0, and the associated POST child spans with http.status_code 200, with no error tags on the traces ffb9b379e6ab520eaa9fb71a95935f9c, 29301c934c2b48bf73ae040929e13638, 26dc024bea07ff130063083b9465ca3e, 53e77c5ff948f37553beb97b1ebeaf05, 7912840a9fda6d411a02e55f9e74f5ff and 072fccebc99383c0ff82a49a057ab979.
Sampled currency spans (Currency/Convert) had durations 223-3566 microseconds with status tags otel.status_code=OK and rpc.grpc.status_code 0, none flagged as errors.

Sampled email spans (POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email, sinatra.render_template) had durations 386-20266 microseconds; the POST /send_order_confirmation spans carried http.status_code 200 and no span was flagged as an error.
The payment transaction counter increase over 5-minute windows was non-zero and positive throughout the window, between 3.75 and 10.77 transactions per 5 minutes for service payment.

Server-side RPC call counts for product-catalog GetProduct and ListProducts and checkout PlaceOrder were all reported with rpc_grpc_status_code 0 only, with rates of roughly 0.36-0.45, 0.021-0.042 and 0.0125-0.036 per second respectively.

Within this 300-second window the reported elevated checkout errors are not corroborated: the sampled checkout traces and the returned checkout/dependency metric series show success status codes only, and the ERROR-labeled series that were returned are all zero. This is consistent with a checkout error signature that is either absent in this window, below sampling thresholds, or not represented in the metric labels that were returned.

The absence of a checkout ERROR series cannot be read as a measured zero error rate: the status_code=ERROR span query returned series for only four services (frontend, frontend-proxy, load-generator, payment), and the checkout calls metric returned only a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series, so error counts for checkout are not directly observed in the supplied metrics.

Checkout's server-side p95 of 93-220 ms sits well above the highest sampled checkout client-side dependency p95 (~45 ms for GetQuote) and above every sampled dependency span duration, so latency on the checkout path is not uniformly low; with no pre-window baseline this cannot establish an upward trend, but it does mean a 'no latency finding' statement would be unsupported.

Hypothesis that one or more of checkout's dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) failed during the window is rejected for the sampled evidence: every returned dependency span carried rpc.grpc.status_code 0, otel.status_code OK or http.status_code 200 with error_by_visible_tags false, the dependency call-count series carried only STATUS_CODE_UNSET/OK labels, and the payment ERROR-labeled series were 0 throughout.

Sampled product-catalog spans (GetProduct and ListProducts) returned 20 spans with durations 219-1797 microseconds, all with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 and no error tags, on traceIDs including 3bc8758b40d49f0e8c8408785651f725, e1b5bd09eb15e3f9a17b26ffc09ccc76, f2ed7fb5a715ed48299f3cffc547ccff and e8802d7dd4571fc45528eda68656e615; this view was flagged incomplete.

gaps: No pre-window or comparison baseline was authorized, so elevated latency for checkout or its dependencies cannot be assessed as a trend; only within-window values (checkout p95 220 ms falling to ~94-96 ms) are observed.

No ERROR-labeled metric series was returned for checkout, cart, currency, shipping, email or product-catalog, and the checkout calls metric contained only a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series, so per-service error rates for checkout and most dependencies are unknown rather than zero.

The p95 server-duration query returned series for only checkout and product-catalog; no server-latency series was returned for payment, cart, currency, shipping or email, so their server-side latency is unknown.

Trace results are sampled (limit 20 per service) and the frontend and product-catalog trace views were flagged incomplete; parent references were frequently marked parent_is_visible=false, so no complete checkout call chain can be asserted and error spans outside the sampled view remain possible.

No log, event, Kubernetes-state, flagd flag-configuration or deployment-change evidence was gathered, so any cause of a checkout symptom (traffic regime, flag state, resource pressure) is unknown and unevaluated.

The rpc_client_duration and rpc_server_duration histogram series report only quantiles/counts; histogram buckets are cumulative and were not used to derive absolute call volumes, so checkout request volumes per dependency are not established.
next_steps: Compare the same checkout and dependency metric set against an earlier (pre-incident) window of equal length before drawing any latency-trend conclusion.
Enumerate the full label set of the checkout span calls metric (including any status_code variants) and of any HTTP/gRPC error counters rather than relying on a single status_code=ERROR filter.
Review checkout service logs and any platform events for the window 07:05:05-07:10:05 UTC to look for failures not represented in sampled traces or returned metric series.

Check whether flagd feature-flag state (for example payment failure or latency fault injections in the OTel Demo) or a recent rollout can explain a checkout symptom that the sampled telemetry does not show.
